nodes.description: Public initializer that mints the initial supply, sets up DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINTER_ROLE for ownerAccount and then pauses the token.
External function restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE that unpauses the token.
Pure function returning the contract version string.
External function that checks MINTER_ROLE for msg.sender and mints tokens to a recipient.
External function that checks allowance of the caller and burns tokens from an account after reducing allowance.
Internal function increasing total supply and balances when creating tokens.
Internal function reducing balance and total supply when destroying tokens.
Internal function setting allowance of spender over owner tokens.
View function returning the remaining allowance of spender for owner.
Internal function moving tokens between accounts and updating balances.
View function returning whether an account holds a role, used for access control checks.
Constant bytes32 role identifier required for minting.
Constant bytes32 default admin role used to gate unpause.
Mapping of account balances updated by mint, burn and transfer.
Nested mapping of allowances updated by _approve and read by allowance.
Total token supply updated by _mint and _burn.
Boolean pause flag toggled by _pause/_unpause and read by whenPaused/whenNotPaused.
Caller-controlled address used for role and allowance checks.
Privileged creation of new tokens to an arbitrary recipient via _mint.
Arithmetic computation of currentAllowance - amount used in burnFrom before burning.
Parameter of initialize receiving initial supply and admin/minter roles.
Recipient parameter of mint.
Amount parameter of mint controlling tokens created.
Account parameter of burnFrom whose tokens are burned.
Amount parameter of burnFrom controlling tokens destroyed.
Local variable in burnFrom holding the caller allowance for the account.

edges.reason: mint uses msg.sender to check MINTER_ROLE before allowing token creation.
Recipient argument of mint flows into the _mint call.
Amount argument of mint flows into the _mint call.
mint invokes internal _mint to create tokens.
msg.sender is passed to hasRole to verify MINTER_ROLE.
mint calls hasRole to gate the operation.
MINTER_ROLE constant is the role queried in hasRole.
Untrusted amount feeds the privileged minting operation.
mint triggers creation of arbitrary token amounts.
burnFrom queries allowance using the account parameter.
account parameter is used in burnFrom logic.
msg.sender (_msgSender) determines whose allowance is spent in burnFrom.
currentAllowance local used for allowance check and subtraction in burnFrom.
currentAllowance participates in the allowance subtraction operation.
burnAmount is subtracted from currentAllowance in burnFrom.
burnFrom calls _approve to reduce the caller allowance.
burnFrom calls _burn to destroy tokens.
_burn updates the _balances mapping.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
allowance reads from the _allowances mapping.
ownerAccount parameter determines initial supply and role assignment in initialize.
initialize calls _mint to create the initial supply.
initialize grants MINTER_ROLE for ownerAccount.
initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE for ownerAccount.
initialize pauses the token by setting the _paused flag.
ownerAccount receives the initially minted tokens.
unpause clears the _paused state variable.
unpause is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: ownerAccount is a parameter used only by initialize and should be folded into that function node.
to parameter of mint flows directly into the _mint operation node.
amount parameter of mint flows directly into the _mint operation node.
account parameter of burnFrom is used only inside burnFrom.
burnAmount parameter of burnFrom only serves the burnFrom allowance logic.
currentAllowance local variable exists only within burnFrom.
